description: TIWAG Hochspannungsleitungen is a dataset listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by tinetz.at. All high-voltage cables in TIWAG's supply area in Tyrol. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "TIWAG high-voltage cables" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
